## error is a value

Errors are ordinary values implementing `error`. Check and return them explicitly — no exceptions.

## Wrapping

Add context with `fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err)`. Unwrap and inspect with `errors.Is` (sentinel match) and `errors.As` (type match).

## Sentinels vs types

Export sentinel errors (`var ErrNotFound = errors.New(...)`) for simple checks; custom error types when callers need extra fields.
